name: Commander Acknowledgment Transaction and Audit Repair
goal: Prevent acknowledgment persistence from owning an existing caller transaction and remove duplicate audit disposition totals without changing normal Commander behavior.

tasks.name: Enforce transaction ownership and canonical audit totals
tasks.description: A sequential Terra worker adds RED tests, the idle-transaction guard, and deletion-only audit cleanup, then runs focused regressions and stages only its four files.

steps.description: Add one real-SQLite active-transaction RED test that verifies through the caller connection that its pending objective remains and no acknowledgement exists before rollback, while an independent reader sees neither write; expose in_transaction on the existing failure test double; update two audit tests to require only Directives, Acknowledged, and Unresolved totals.
Run the three exact RED tests.
steps.expected: FAIL because the helper does not raise and both duplicate audit labels remain.

steps.description: Add the idle-transaction RuntimeError before any helper SQL and delete only the two duplicate audit summary lines.
Run the exact three tests GREEN.
Run focused helper, audit, MCP, and transport regression.
steps.command: cd /Users/roberthyatt/Code/ironclaude/commander && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_db.py tests/test_daemon.py tests/test_orchestrator_mcp.py -k 'operator_message_acknowledgement or audit or transport_acknowledgement or TestAcknowledgeOperatorMessage'

steps.description: Stage only Task 1 files and run staged diff check.
steps.command: git -C /Users/roberthyatt/Code/ironclaude add -- commander/src/ironclaude/db.py commander/src/ironclaude/main.py commander/tests/test_db.py commander/tests/test_daemon.py && git -C /Users/roberthyatt/Code/ironclaude diff --staged --check
steps.expected: Four Task 1 files staged; exit 0; no commit or push.
